text: Sesame HR is a Valencia-based HR-software company backed by PSG Equity (a Series A investor) and, per a May 2024 announcement, a new €23 million round led by GP Bullhound with PSG's participation.

source.name: PSG Equity press release on Sesame's EUR 23m round; GP Bullhound Fund VI announcement
source.quote: The new round is led by GP Bullhound with participation from Series A investor PSG.
